decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby acknowledge the 28 day notification period and certify that on 29th September 2005 the proposed installation of 2 additional dishes, 3 antennae and ancillary telecommunication equipment cabinets was lawful within the meaning of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and that prior approval is not required for the following reason:

The Local Planning Authority is satisfied that Condition A.2 (1) is adequately complied with and the proposed development, so far as is practicable, would be sited so as to minimise its effect on the appearance of the area.
description: Installation of 2 additional dishes, 3 antennae and ancillary telecommunications equipment. (Notification)
